runs.final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Home' THEN be.bsns_entt_id END) AS home_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Shipping' THEN be.bsns_entt_id END) AS shipping_count FROM biz_addr ba JOIN addr_typ at ON ba.ref1 = at.addr_typ_id JOIN biz_ent be ON ba.ref3 = be.bsns_entt_id WHERE at.nm IN ('Home', 'Shipping')

SELECT CONCAT(prsn.frst_nm, ' ', prsn.lst_nm) AS sales_person, sls_terr.nm AS territory
FROM stor
JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref2
JOIN prsn ON sls_prsn.ref2 = prsn.ref1
JOIN sls_terr ON sls_prsn.ref1 = sls_terr.trrt_id
WHERE stor.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'

SELECT DISTINCT v.nm
FROM vnd v
JOIN prod_vnd pv ON v.ref1 = pv.ref2
JOIN prod p ON pv.ref3 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_mdl pm ON p.ref1 = pm.prdc_mdl_id
WHERE pm.nm = 'Women''s Tights'
SELECT MAX(bm_lvl) FROM bom WHERE ref3 = (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58')

SELECT pc.nm, COALESCE(SUM(sod.ordr_qty), 0) AS total_quantity_sold, COALESCE(SUM(sod.ln_ttl), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM prod_cat pc
LEFT JOIN prod_sub ps ON pc.prdc_ctgr_id = ps.ref1
LEFT JOIN prod p ON ps.prdc_sbct_id = p.ref2
LEFT JOIN so_dtl sod ON p.prdc_id = sod.ref2
GROUP BY pc.prdc_ctgr_id, pc.nm

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM so_hdr JOIN addr ON so_hdr.ref5 = addr.addr_id JOIN st_prv ON addr.ref1 = st_prv.stt_prvn_id JOIN cnty ON st_prv.ref2 = cnty.cntr_rgn_cd WHERE cnty.nm = 'Canada' AND YEAR(so_hdr.ordr_dt) = 2013

SELECT p.nm
FROM prod p
WHERE p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM so_dtl sod
  WHERE sod.ref2 = p.prdc_id
)

SELECT SUM(sd.ln_ttl)
FROM so_dtl sd
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sd.ref3 = sh.sls_ordr_id
JOIN prod p ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Bikes' AND YEAR(sh.ordr_dt) = 2013
